intents.intent: CLI entry point with commands for build, analyze, tasks, apply, query, architect, arch-search, and all other codegraph operations
Multi-candidate architecture search engine module. Generates, simulates, scores, and ranks architecture improvement candidates.
Generate architecture improvement candidates from advisor findings. Reads architecture_advice.json and produces candidates representing different refactoring strategies.
Simulate each candidate using architecture_simulator to predict impact on metrics without modifying code.
Score and rank candidates using weighted architecture metrics: score improvement, coupling, fan-out, violations, and risk level.
Orchestrate the full multi-candidate architecture search: generate, simulate, score, rank, select best candidate or report no safe change.
Convert a candidate refactoring strategy into simulatable ArchChange objects for the architecture simulator.
Record the architecture search decision to persistent architecture memory for future learning.
Extract a short module name from a file path or node ID for use in candidate IDs.
Find which subsystem a module belongs to by searching architecture component definitions.
CLI command for multi-candidate architecture search. Runs arch-search with optional JSON output and save.
